gen-megrim-gf-truculenta: Megrim draws every stroke at a measured, constant thickness, all angles and futuristic edges. Truculenta counters with short ascenders and a tall, compact lowercase whose rounded forms stay friendly.
gen-megrim-gf-ubuntu: Hairline-thin, monoline strokes give Megrim its stark, angular look. Ubuntu, a plain sans with a lofty lowercase band, holds up if the heading ever gets small.
gen-megrim-gf-victor-mono: Megrim's c opens as wide as a bent paperclip, and every stroke keeps one measured thickness. Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left unfinished on one side, gives the pair its precise, structured edge.
gen-megrim-gf-viga: Megrim is angular and futuristic, built from strokes of one measured thickness throughout. And Viga, a sans with hairline-free, shadow-free strokes and capitals barely taller than their neighbors, does the quiet everyday work.
gen-megrim-gf-voces: Voces is a sans with tall lowercase and a gentle ebb and flow in its stroke thickness. Megrim's one-pen-tip lines sit above it like a futuristic sketch.
gen-megrim-gf-winky-rough: Megrim's marker-nib line ignores direction entirely. Winky Rough, a sans with a body height nearly matching its capitals, keeps a long page contemporary and businesslike without fuss.
gen-megrim-gf-winky-sans: Sharp, angular and a bit sci-fi, Megrim traces every stroke at the width of a single stylus. Winky Sans, with capitals barely above lowercase, is the modern, neutral one for steady text.
gen-megrim-gf-yantramanav: Futuristic from the first glyph, Megrim skims along on a stroke weight that never changes. And Yantramanav, a sans-serif with tall lowercase and spacious terminal gaps, is what makes the pair feel modern and clean.
gen-megrim-outfit: Angular in every line, Megrim holds a skyward x-height and strokes of one measured thickness. Outfit, a sans with curves that finish well before they close, has a moderate lowercase that can run slightly larger than you'd expect.
gen-megrim-plus-jakarta-sans: Modern and precise, with curve endings kept well apart, Plus Jakarta Sans reads like cable bent into clean shapes. Megrim brings a skyward x-height and angular, futuristic edges, and that high-versus-moderate lowercase gap is the pair's real strength.
